topic: In chapter 1059, Blackbeard choked Hancock, and her only answer was a warning about his own crew
title: Hancock Bluffed Blackbeard While He Choked Her
description: In chapter 1059, Blackbeard had Boa Hancock by the throat and tried to steal her Mero Mero no Mi. Her only answer was a warning about the petrified crew he never cared about. I think that bluff says more about her loyalty than any speech. Was it a bluff or a real threat?
comment: Was Hancock's warning to Blackbeard a bluff or a real threat? Pick one.

lines.text: Blackbeard had Boa Hancock by the throat, and she still had one card to play.

shot.fallback: pirate with a black beard holding an empress by the throat

lines.text: Chapter 1059. Teach came for her and her Mero Mero no Mi.

shot.search: Teach Amazon Lily Hancock Mero Mero
shot.fallback: dark pirate attacking an island beach

lines.text: He choked her and shut her power off, so for once she had no move left.
Her card was a warning: take my life, and your petrified crew stays stone forever.

shot.fallback: empress glaring at a pirate captain

lines.text: Teach's reply is the tell. He told her he does not even care about his crewmates.

shot.fallback: pirate captain smirking with a cold look

lines.text: Two of his Titanic Captains, Catarina Devon and Vasco Shot, were still stone.

shot.fallback: two pirates turned to stone on a beach

lines.text: Then Rayleigh walked in, and Teach backed off without the fruit.

shot.fallback: old swordsman walking onto a beach

lines.text: Rayleigh admitted Teach would beat him in a real fight, because of Rayleigh's age.

shot.fallback: old swordsman facing a dark pirate

lines.text: My read: her bluff worked because Teach feared Rayleigh more than he cared about his crew.

shot.fallback: pirate captain glancing back in fear

lines.text: Whether that bluff was a vow or just survival is the question I'm still weighing.

shot.fallback: empress standing on a beach at dusk

lines.text: Blackbeard had her by the throat, and her only weapon was a warning about a crew he never cared about.
